resources.string: To create insights, the app will send your daily income and expense totals for the past %1$d days, grouped by category and currency, to a third-party service. After you agree, the app will also create an insight each week in the background and show it in a notification. Up to %1$d generated insights will be stored on this device and may be sent to the service to avoid repeats. Notes are not sent.
Insights are unavailable right now. Please try again later.
Not enough data for an insight yet. Add transactions over at least %1$d days and try again.
You can generate one insight per day. Please come back tomorrow.
